description: Happy path: Consumer-reported health:SocialHistoryRecord with all four v2.4 properties (smoking, alcohol, exercise, occupational exposure)
notes: health v2.4 added health:SocialHistoryRecord plus health:smokingStatus, health:alcoholUse, health:exerciseFrequency, health:occupationalExposure.
